title: Synapse — a visual builder for AI agents
description: A light, spring-animated landing page for a no-code AI agent builder. The whole hero is a dotted canvas: every node drags with its wires following, one connection is missing, and the visitor draws it from the dangling port to unlock Run, which sends a pulse down the flow and reports a test result. A glue-code versus canvas comparison, a build bento, a pinned testing story, a deploy dock and pricing follow.
features: Draggable node canvas whose bezier wires follow through motion values, re-laid out vertically on phones
Drag-to-connect the missing step (or press Enter on the port), with an elastic wire that springs back if dropped short
Run sends a pulse along every wire, lights each node in turn and reports a test result
Before and after slider: a prompt-and-glue file against the same agent as steps
Liquid add-step dial, design-tool scrub fields and knowledge upload chips
Voice test orb, run trace, version scores and one-click rollback
Channel dock that switches deploy targets on, plus a copyable agent ID
